facts.text: The hotel is on Azadliq Square, near Baku Boulevard, Government House and Neftchilar Avenue.
facts.excerpt: a 5-star hotel on Azadliq Square, near Baku Boulevard, Government House and Neftchilar Avenue

facts.text: The baroque-style Government House on Neftchiler Avenue is located just opposite the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Located just opposite the hotel, the opulent baroque-style Government House on Neftchiler Avenue was built in 1952.

facts.text: Absheron Spa is on the 21st floor, with views of Baku city and the Caspian Sea.
facts.excerpt: Located on the 21st floor, Absheron Spa offers breathtaking views of Baku city and the Caspian Sea.

facts.text: Absheron Spa has a treatment room designed for couple treatments, a steam room and a Finnish sauna.
facts.excerpt: there are 5 treatment rooms, one of which is designed for couple treatments, steam room, Finnish sauna, indoor swimming pool and state-of-the-art fitness center

facts.text: The top-floor heated indoor pool has a jacuzzi and floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: Our top-floor heated swimming pool with jacuzzi is a real sanctuary within the urban buzz of the city's business district. Indoor pool with floor-to-ceiling windows

facts.text: The gym offers panoramic views from the 23rd floor.
facts.excerpt: Elevate your workout experience at our well-equipped gym, offering stunning panoramic views from the 23rd floor of JW Marriott Absheron Baku.

facts.text: The JW Garden includes an herb garden with mint, chili and basil.
facts.excerpt: the invigorating scents of mint, chili, and basil in our herb garden

facts.text: The JW Garden has a cozy lounge area with comfortable swings.
facts.excerpt: Find your ultimate relaxation spot in the cozy lounge area, where comfortable swings await

facts.text: The Badikube in the lobby, inspired by the Baku wind, has a library of Azerbaijani books.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in a moment of tranquility within the Badikube, a haven in the lobby of JW Marriott Absheron Baku inspired by the "Baku wind“. Delve into the library's curated collection of Azerbaijani books

facts.text: All rooms come with views, either of the sea or of the city.
facts.excerpt: All of our rooms in Baku come with stunning views, it's up to you whether you choose a relaxing sea view or a room overlooking the busy city.

facts.text: Rooms have marble bathrooms with luxury bath products.
facts.excerpt: Pamper yourself in the marble bathrooms in our Azerbaijan rooms, filled with luxury bath products.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a sea view and a balcony.
facts.excerpt: 1 Bedroom Presidential Suite, 1 King, Sea view, Balcony

facts.text: Fireworks Urban Kitchen is a steakhouse with a city view and a spacious outdoor terrace with fire bowls.
facts.excerpt: With a stunning city view, this intimate terrace Baku restaurant offers perfectly prepared steaks, captivating ambiance and a spacious outdoor terrace with fire bowls.

facts.text: The Tea Lounge offers teas from around the globe and a taste of Baku's local tea ceremony.
facts.excerpt: Savor the flavors of Baku's local tea ceremony as you indulge in our array of delectable pastries at the Tea Lounge.

facts.text: OroNero Bar & Ristorante serves Italian cuisine with Mediterranean and Sicilian flavors.
facts.excerpt: Our menu is a celebration of the finest Mediterranean and Sicilian flavors.

facts.text: Children can solve riddles on a treasure hunt in the JW Garden called the Secret Garden.
facts.excerpt: solving riddles and uncovering the hidden treasures that lie within our JW Garden

facts.text: The JW Executive Concierge Lounge is on the 5th floor.
facts.excerpt: Experience intentional service and mindful experiences in the Executive Lounge of JW Marriott Absheron Baku. Located on the 5th floor

facts.text: The Sharq Zali Ballroom has floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic views of the Caspian Sea and Baku's skyline.
facts.excerpt: Your guests will be wowed with its floor-to-ceiling windows and panoramic views of the Caspian Sea and Baku’s skyline.

facts.text: Pets are welcome.
facts.excerpt: Pets Welcome.

facts.text: The hotel is about 23.2 km from Heydar Aliyev International Airport.
facts.excerpt: GYD is located approximately 23.2 KM from the hotel.

facts.text: Self parking on site is complimentary for guests.
facts.excerpt: On-site self parking is available at JW Marriott Absheron Baku. Self parking is complimentary for guests.

facts.text: The concierge team can help guests explore the historic Old City on foot or arrange a guided transfer to the Fire Temple.
facts.excerpt: Whether you choose to explore the historic Old City on foot or embark on a guided transfer to the mystical Fire Temple, let us help you create unforgettable memories in this captivating city.
